oaks_own.title: Focus on developing your faith in God and in Jesus Christ
items: Focus on developing your faith in God and the mission of His Son, Jesus Christ.

oaks_own.title: Hold on to the first article of faith, and wait upon the Lord
items: Hold on to the first article of faith even if something else is uncertain. And while you wait, wait upon the Lord

oaks_own.title: Keep the commandments and be true to your covenants
items: I urge you to keep the commandments and be true to the covenants so many of you have made
Keep your covenants, strive to be faithful
Always put Him first and remain faithful to the covenants you made at your baptism.

oaks_own.title: Never let your secular learning limit your spiritual horizons
items: Never let your secular learning limit your spiritual horizons.

oaks_own.title: Protect yourself by renewing your covenants through the sacrament each week
items: Protect yourself with the weekly renewing of your covenants by partaking of the sacrament
let us not miss the unifying power of the sacrament
Partake of the sacrament with a humble heart

oaks_own.title: Believe the Book of Mormon's promises that God's grace is for all
items: These promises from the Book of Mormon are true. Millions believe them and have had experiences to affirm their truth. I invite all to believe them.

oaks_own.title: Act on these truths and share them with others
items: I call upon all to act on these truths and to share them with others
I invite you to do something that is as simple as gospel fruit is delicious: love, share, and invite.

oaks_own.title: Study and ponder this conference's talks, and act on them
items: we invite all to study and ponder them prayerfully and to act in faith on the principles they explain
let us not be guilty of holding “the oracles of God … as a light thing”

oaks_own.title: Learn about the Salt Lake Temple celebration
items: Join us at TempleSquare.org or through the Temple Square app to learn more.

oaks_repeated.title: Forgo contention and use the language of peacemakers
items: let us follow Him by forgoing contention and by using the language and methods of peacemakers
let us use words that encourage understanding and peace
let us fill our hearts with the true doctrine of Christ
Let us repent for the harsh language and expressions that have offended our friends, leaders, family members, or colleagues.
Let us pray for peaceful communication among us, regardless of the difference in our opinions.
Let us use the language that uplifts, edifies, comforts, and brings people together.

oaks_repeated.title: Avoid what is harsh and hateful; seek to be holy like the Savior
items: Let us avoid what is harsh and hateful. Let us seek to be holy, like our Savior.
let us avoid what is harsh and hateful

oaks_repeated.title: Seek friends who are striving to follow the Lord
items: Seek friends … who are striving to follow the Lord … with whom you can feel the Spirit and … reinforce your faith.

others.title: Look each day for chances to bear witness of Jesus Christ
items: I invite you to look each day for opportunities, as prompted by the Holy Ghost, to bear witness of Jesus Christ and His restored gospel
Please trust it, nurture it, and bear it, because it is uniquely yours.

others.title: Come unto Christ as you are, and invite one person to come too
items: I invite you, please come unto Christ and embrace His promise
Will you find one person and invite him or her to come unto Christ

others.title: When life doesn't make sense, choose Christ and trust Him
items: Let’s choose Christ, who can heal the wounds of this world while carving out room for joy!
I echo the Savior’s words: “Be not afraid, only believe.”

others.title: Remember God's mercies, and erase the "asterisk" that excludes you
items: Strive to remember all the times He has inclined His ear to you
take out a big eraser and obliterate that asterisk

others.title: Never give up on loved ones who have wandered; give your despair to Christ
items: I ask you to turn over to Jesus Christ your despair for those wayward souls.
First, let go of any guilt.
never, never give up on those you love
Pray mightily to our Heavenly Father in the name of Jesus Christ.

others.title: See the person in front of you, and minister to them
items: let us pray every day for eyes to see the divine appointments God places before us!
Let us put compassion into action and minister to the person in front of us.
I plead with you as disciples of Jesus Christ to pray to see others as He sees them and to treat them accordingly.
This week, I invite you to: Learn the name of someone who may feel unseen.
Pray to see others as Heavenly Father sees them.
Never let a problem to be solved become more important than a person to be loved.
encourage others to join Him in keeping His promise today and in the hard days ahead

others.title: Help friends and new members in more Christlike ways: quick to help, slow to judge
items: we are invited to reorient our souls so we may help friends and new members in more Christlike ways

others.title: Replace worldly labels with eternal truths about who people are
items: Replace worldly labels with these eternal truths: Child of God. Child of the covenant. Disciple of Jesus Christ.

others.title: Join the Christ-centered unity: come and see, come and help, come and belong
items: I invite you to join the Christ-centered unity we are trying to build.
Please, come and see, come and help, and come and belong.

others.title: Stand for truth with love
items: I also hope that you will look deeply into your [own] heart to see if there are shards of pride or jealousy that prevent you from becoming a peacemaker.” I extend that same invitation to all of us today.
Ask yourself if you carry these Christlike attributes when you are striving to stand for truth with love

others.title: Search the scriptures diligently
items: I invite you to search the scriptures diligently, that you might know the word of God
Study the scriptures with a desire to know God’s character
Seek Him through study of the scriptures and words of prophets, apostles, men and women leaders who are devoted to serving the Lord.

others.title: Remember the small and simple things: scriptures, prayer, sacrament, and covenants
items: I invite you to always remember scriptures, prayers, the sacrament, and covenants.

others.title: Begin each day seeking the companionship of the Holy Ghost
items: Begin each day by asking the Father for that companionship.
Actively tune in to the sweet feelings of the Holy Spirit and the things in your life that lead you there.
Pay close attention to the sweet, peaceful feelings that come when you choose spiritual lift

others.title: Repent daily, and don't put it off
items: Please “do not procrastinate the day of your repentance until the end.”
Repent daily and at the end of the day, as you pray, ask for forgiveness.
Let us ponder about the changes that we need to make in our lives

others.title: Climb toward spiritual "lift": find a guide, join the climbers, turn away from sinking
items: Find a faithful guide and learn from them where lift is found.
Join those who are climbing. Do what they do.
Watch closely for the subtle signs of sink in your own life, and turn away decisively.
And when you find lift yourself, show someone else where and how to rise!

others.title: Honor the temple: speak of it with gratitude and treasure its blessings
items: Please let us never speak of a temple as big or small, elaborate or plain.
let us celebrate and treasure even more the spiritual blessings temples bring
let us always be grateful for the gifts of eternity sacred temples bring
please consider saving for and buying your own ceremonial temple clothes
come worship and rejoice with the Lord in the house of the Lord

others.title: Be a strong link in your family's eternal chain
items: in the chain of your eternal family, please be a strong link

others.title: Live the law of the fast in a higher, holier way
items: I invite you to prayerfully ponder Isaiah’s teachings and more intentionally embrace the divine purpose of the law of the fast in a higher and holier way

others.title: Refrain from gambling, and use the time and money for good
items: my plea again is not only to refrain from gambling but to use the time and resources saved thereby for doing good
Today, I am pleading with all of us to live life on a higher plane.

others.title: Teachers: come unto the Master Teacher, learn of Him, and love Him
items: Come unto the Master Teacher. Learn of Him. Love Him.
Love the Lord and love those you teach.

others.title: Rising generation: place a full-time mission high on your list
items: I invite you to place serving a full-time mission high on your list.
Pray to know if the Lord would have you serve a mission.
I invite each of you to substitute your name for Thomas’s

others.title: Young women: choose one way to grow, protect your sleep, limit phone use, and write your list of aspirations
items: I invite you to listen to the Spirit to choose one to focus on over the next few weeks.
Protect your sleep; go to bed early.
I invite you to study the thirteenth article of faith and to create your own list of aspirations.
I invite you to look at your life and what you want to achieve with enthusiasm
Study what it means to have ministering angels help you.
